active_disproof.DRTRAINSET21-001: The counter-hypothesis that 9.1 is intentionally cited because it itself contains an example-based re-initialisation use case was tested. Section 9.1 does contain such a use case. However, overview item 4 already assigns the re-initialisation problem to sections 7 and 9, while item 5 separately introduces examples of service interaction; section 10 is explicitly titled Examples and contains multiple cross-service use cases. The 9.1 pointer is therefore retained as a stale/wrong cross-reference.
